blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—On paper, the NU Pep Squad was the runaway winner in the UAAP Season 89 Cheerdance Competition. For NU coach Gab Bajacan, though, the numbers simply don’t tell the whole story. Even with a historic tenth title and another three-peat achieved, Bajacan said that defending their throne wasn’t easy against a challenging field. READ: NU Pep Squad claims UAAP Cheerdance three-peat, wins 10th title “It’s hard because all the teams competing here now are all friends, that includes coaches and players,” he said on Saturday night. “We’re all friends, so it’s hard to come here and compete against each other.” […]...
